purpose: Discovery arm. Finds companies that are growing, raising, hiring in NYC, or under office-space pressure, and hands them to NormanAI-crm-core intake. Research qualifies; it never scores and never writes Notion.

downstream.note: crm_intake.py is the ONLY Notion writer. Rows land at Status=Research and the CB/Careers/LinkedIn lanes enrich before the score agent scores. Research must not pre-empt any of that.

caps.note: Broad funding lanes get maxCandidatesPerLane; tight lanes get maxTightPerLane, because a tight lane returning 25 companies is a sign it stopped being tight.

promote.note: When enabled (or --promote passed), research invokes crm-core's crm_intake.py directly so companies land on the board with no human step. Capped so a bad batch is a small mess.

dedup.note: Notion read is a courtesy pre-filter to cut noise. crm_intake.py remains the authority on dedup.

grok.note: Agent Tools API. The legacy search_parameters Live Search API was retired 2026-01-12 and returns 410. Run `python3 scripts/research_probe.py` to verify the live request shape before trusting a run.
